RD7 measurements and OD3/OD4 owner decisions remain required for operational limits. No input payload cap is selected by the serializer witness.
Qualify native SQL/HTTP settlement, SIGTERM, delivery dependency closure, loader/serializer wiring and transport before any applicable host or production action.
